ledger: man (real, back to camera) | holding white-handled straight razor at chin, head tilted up | razor raised toward cheek/brow, head turned | strokes chin (0.0-1.5s), lifts to cheek/eye (1.75-2.0s), holds razor flat at forehead/hairline with head bowed (2.25-4.0s), snaps upright to eye/cheek (4.25-4.75s), back to chin strokes (5.0-9.25s), raises to cheek/temple (9.5-9.75s)

mirror reflection | should mirror real man's hand/razor/head simultaneously | mostly follows but desyncs | at 00:00.25, 00:06.25 and 00:09.25 the real razor is held away from the skin while the reflected razor is pressed against the chin/cheek; at 00:01.75 and 00:04.25 the real razor is at temple/brow while the reflected razor sits on the nose/eye

razor strokes -> skin/stubble | cause: repeated blade strokes on chin, cheek, forehead throughout 0-10s | effect expected: removal of stubble / shaving residue | no shaving cream, no lather, stubble on chin and upper lip unchanged from 00:00 to 00:09.75 in the reflection
head pose | tilted up at start | upright/slightly turned at end | bow from 2.0-4.0s, abrupt return to upright between 4.0 and 4.25s together with razor relocating from forehead to eye
action cycle | chin-stroke pose at 00:00.0 | near-identical chin-stroke pose recurs at 00:01.0, 00:05.0, 00:06.0, 00:06.5, 00:09.0 | cyclic repetition of the same beat without visible progress

findings.invariant_violated: effect without cause (reflection must be caused by real motion simultaneously)
findings.description: At 00:09.25 the real man holds the razor vertically several centimetres away from his jaw, yet the reflection shows the blade pressed against his cheek. Similar desyncs occur at 00:00.25 and 00:06.25 (real razor off the skin below the chin, reflected razor touching chin/lip) and at 00:01.75/00:04.25 (real razor at temple, reflected razor on nose/eye). The reflection performs contact the real body is not performing.

Ten seconds of repeated straight-razor strokes over chin, cheek and forehead produce no visible effect: no lather or residue, no cleared patches, and the stubble on chin and upper lip in the reflection is unchanged from the first frame to the last.

The same chin-stroke beat (head tilted up, razor at chin, matching hand and reflection pose) recurs almost identically at 00:00.0, 00:01.0, 00:05.0, 00:06.0, 00:06.5 and 00:09.0, giving a looped feel with no progression of the task.

Between 00:04.0 and 00:04.25 the head goes from bowed with the razor held flat at the hairline to fully upright with the razor at the eye/cheek in a single sample, with no transitional pose; the razor-on-forehead hold (2.25-4.0s) also ends without any completed stroke.
